title: FeatureRecord
description: The single join point of the hot and cold paths (ADR-001). Every value carries its own freshness so staleness can never be hidden (ARCHITECTURE §4.2): age < ttl = normal, ttl..3x ttl = flagged stale, >= 3x ttl = dropped/degraded.

feature_name.description: Stable, versioned name — renaming a feature is a breaking change (model input contract).

value.description: Numeric for model inputs; string only for embeddings refs.

event_time.description: Time the underlying fact was true.

confidence.description: Present for llm_signal; decayed before serving.

model_input_version.description: Training/serving feature-set version; training joins on this to avoid skew.
